From: ops@quantlogix.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API eval request — Samira Patel (QuantLogix)

Hi Ben,

I signed up through your hosted API trial and tried to book a live evaluation slot but all of the 30-min PLG slots are booked for the next two weeks. Please add me to the waitlist and let me know if any cancellations open up.

Quick context: we want to validate streaming responses (low-latency chat) and embeddings for a cross-document search proof-of-concept.

Attaching a short one-pager with our use case. Happy to share more if helpful.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Product Lead — Search
QuantLogix
Attachment: quantlogix-demo-brief.pdf (application/pdf, 124 KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: samira@quantlogix.com
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-07T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request — Samira Patel (QuantLogix)

Hi Samira — welcome, and thanks for the note (and the brief). I reviewed it briefly — streaming + embeddings is a great combo and we can show both in a 45‑minute session.

Two quick items:
- Our public PLG calendar filled up faster than usual this month; we maintain a short waitlist for cancellations and occasional extended slots for higher-readiness leads. I added you to the waitlist and gave you priority based on the brief.
- If you're flexible, I can offer one of two options this week if someone cancels: Wed 6/9 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri 6/11 13:00–13:45 PT. If neither works, I'll keep you on the waitlist and notify you ASAP.

Prep I need from you before we confirm: sample API key use-case (one paragraph) and any specific documents you'd like us to try during the session. You already attached the brief which helps.

I'll loop Diego for sandbox provisioning and post-demo follow-up (he's cc'd).

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(Attachment noted: quantlogix-demo-brief.pdf)
From: samira@quantlogix.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-08T08:34:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request — Samira Patel (QuantLogix)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick reply.

Both of those slots could work in principle, but we have a holiday-related scheduling freeze on our side for Wed morning. Could you keep the Fri 6/11 13:00 PT tentative for us and mark me as high-priority on the waitlist if someone cancels earlier? If a cancellation opens earlier, we could try a 30‑minute quick demo instead of 45.

Two clarifications:
- We are on EDT (GMT-4) — I pasted the times in my calendar and they matched your PT notes.
- We will want you to validate both streaming latency and embeddings similarity thresholds; Diego, can you provision a sandbox token scoped to the streaming and embeddings endpoints ahead of the session?

Attached: screenshot of the calendar conflict showing the institutional freeze.

Samira
(Attachment: screenshot-calendar-conflict.png)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: Hosted API eval request — QuantLogix — waitlist / potential Fri 6/11 slot

Marissa — forwarding the thread. QuantLogix is a PLG signup that looks evaluation-ready (streaming + embeddings). Their internal scheduling freeze means Fri 6/11 13:00 PT is our best tentative open slot. They asked for high-priority waitlist if earlier cancellation occurs.

Can you:
1) Hold Fri 6/11 13:00–13:45 PT as a tentative reserved slot for Ben (we'll only publish it if they confirm) and set a reminder to release it 24 hours before if not confirmed.
2) Share the SDR pre-demo checklist link with me (I couldn't find the latest one in Drive) so I can ask Samira for the one-paragraph API use-case and confirm the sandbox token scope.

Diego — please provision a sandbox token scoped to: streaming.chat and embeddings.embed for QuantLogix once we lock the slot (or provide a short-lived token now if that speeds things up).

I'll follow up with Samira once you both confirm.

Thanks —
Ben
